headline: Eicher Motors: SEBI Takeover Disclosure Filed by Promoter-Linked Entities and Individuals
sum: A substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations was filed with NSE by multiple promoter-linked entities and individuals of Eicher Motors Limited, signalling a potential shift in shareholding structure within the group. The disclosure covers multiple trusts and entities associated with the Lal family and executives, filed under Regulation 31(4) and 31(5) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
detail: The disclosure filed with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) by Harish Chawla, members of the Lal family (Simran, Tara, Siddhartha), and associated trusts and entities (including Karvansarai Investments Private Limited) indicates a substantial change in share acquisition or control among existing promoter stakeholders of Eicher Motors. Under Regulation 31(4)–(5) of the SEBI Takeover Code, any individual or entity acquiring 25% or more of voting rights, or acquiring shares such that their aggregate crosses 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, or 90%, must disclose to the stock exchange within 4 trading days. The filing does not specify the quantum or price, suggesting this may be an internal group restructuring or trust-related reorganisation rather than an external acquisition.
